rachats.citation: STMicroelectronics has completed its acquisition of Swedish SiC wafer manufacturer Norstel AB. ... The total consideration for the acquisition of Norstel was $137.5 million, funded with available cash.
BUSINESS COMBINATIONS In the first half of 2020, the Company closed the acquisition of French Gallium Nitride (GaN) innovator Exagan.

In the second half of 2020, the Company closed the acquisitions of the entire share capital of Ultra Wide Band specialist BeSpoon, of the cellular IoT connectivity assets of Riot Micro and of the radio- frequency assets of SOMOS.
In 2021, we acquired Edge-AI Software specialist, Cartesiam.
